about.name: Coach Brandon Castro
about.title: K, LS, CB
about.bio:
Coach Brandon Castro brings 4 years of experience running the N system in California. With a sharp offensive mind and a track record of developing athletes who perform at the next level, Coach Castro is known for making practice reps count. Works with athletes at the Middle School, Youth level.

From route running to pre-snap reads to protection schemes — Coach Castro delivers the kind of coaching that shows up in the box score.

hero.headline: California Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized offensive football coaching that turns potential into performance.

services.title: N System Coaching
services.description: Installation and development of the N offense — from core concepts to advanced adjustments that put defenses in conflict.

services.title: Skill Position Development
services.description: Individual coaching for QBs, WRs, RBs, and TEs focused on technique, route running, footwork, and pre-snap reads.

services.title: Offensive Playbook & Film Study
services.description: Playbook design tailored to your personnel, plus film sessions that sharpen in-game decision making for players and staff.
